metadata.description: Marketplace catalog for Stride GitHub Copilot CLI plugins

plugins.name: stride-copilot
plugins.description: Task lifecycle skills and custom agents for Stride kanban: claiming, completing, and creating tasks and goals for AI agents in GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: stride-copilot-ideation
plugins.description: Turn an idea into shipped Stride tasks from GitHub Copilot CLI: an interactive ideation session that produces a committed requirements doc, plus a stridify step that decomposes it into a Stride batch and posts it to the API.

plugins.name: stride-copilot-security-review
plugins.description: AI-powered security review for code changes via the security-review-essentials skill: multi-language semantic vulnerability detection with SARIF output and CI severity gating.

plugins.name: stride-copilot-lite
plugins.description: Produce Stride-shaped goal and task markdown documents on disk from a free-text prompt — no API calls, no kanban auth. New in v0.4.0: the hook layer actually fires on Copilot CLI (before_task, after_task and after_goal were all inert), plus a decision matrix, task enrichment, hook-failure triage, step telemetry, three optional cross-plugin integrations, and the failed-verdict note rule the completion API already enforces. Breaking: the four skill directories were renamed.

plugins.name: launchdarkly-copilot
plugins.description: Generate correct, testable, and removable LaunchDarkly feature-flag code from GitHub Copilot — Java server SDK plus the TypeScript SDKs (Node server, client-side JS, React) with scaffolding, flag-removal skills, and an anti-pattern review agent.

plugins.name: stride-copilot-exploratory-testing
plugins.description: Structured, charter-based exploratory testing for GitHub Copilot CLI: plan charters, run timeboxed sessions with named heuristics and oracles, and capture findings — the Copilot port of cheezy/stride-exploratory-testing.
